scripts.dev: concurrently -n ui-kit,identity,webonone,media,company -c magenta,blue,cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:ui-kit" "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:webonone" "npm run dev:media" "npm run dev:company"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:packages && npm run install:identity && npm run install:webonone && npm run install:media && npm run install:company && npm ls --workspaces --depth=0
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:platform-nav && npm run build:theme && npm run build:ui-kit && npm run build:media-embed
scripts.build:all: npm run install:all && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @webonone/identity-frontend && npm run build -w @webonone/identity-backend && npm run build -w @webonone/webonone-frontend && npm run build -w @webonone/webonone-backend && npm run build -w @webonone/media-frontend && npm run build -w @webonone/media-backend
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:all && npm run stage:deploy -w identity-root && npm run stage:deploy -w webonone-v2-root && npm run stage:deploy -w media-root
